name: Margin Collateral Report 4
definition: Details of margin collateral agreement between counterparties.

CollateralPortfolioCode.name: Collateral Portfolio Code
CollateralPortfolioCode.definition: Specifies the unique code assigned by the reporting counterparty to the portfolio if the collateral is posted on a portfolio basis.||Usage:|NoCode is reported if the collateralisation was performed on a transaction level basis, or if there is no collateral agreement or if no collateral is posted or received.

CollateralisationCategory.name: Collateralisation Category
CollateralisationCategory.definition: Indicates the type of collateral agreement existing between the counterparties.

TimeStamp.name: Time Stamp
TimeStamp.definition: Indicates the date and time of the last collateral amount determination or calculation.
